documentation.description: Generation of mutations from Ada source text.

simple_types.name: Mutator_Kind
simple_types.code:
type Mutator_Kind is
  (Arithmetic_Operator,
   Equality_Operator,
   Logical_Operator,
   Unary_Operator,
   Boolean_Literal,
   Membership_Operator,
   Conditional_Expression,
   Statement_Deletion,
   Numeric_Literal,
   String_Literal);

array_types.name: Mutator_Set
array_types.code: type Mutator_Set is array (Mutator_Kind) of Boolean;

an "adamutant:disable" comment covers the mutation.
